articles.title: Treasuries rise as falling oil eases pressure on Fed
articles.description: Treasury yields declined on Tuesday as oil prices dropped significantly. This decrease followed reports of progress toward resolving the Iran conflict. Lower oil prices reduced inflation expectations and Fed rate hike forecasts. The two-year note yield reached its lowest point since late July. The benchmark ten-year yield settled at 4.62 percent.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks advance on Hormuz deal hopes
articles.description: Asian stocks are set to track Wall Street higher as optimism grows. Prospects for an interim deal with Iran eased energy supply concerns significantly. This development has led to a slide in oil prices and reduced inflation pressures. Investors are now watching for further progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz. This situation may strengthen the case for the Federal Reserve to keep interest rates unchanged.
